entries.4788ebabe982e152: The company was established in 1971 as Yugen-gaisha Alps Giken and is headquartered in Minatomirai, Nishi-ku, Yokohama, Kanagawa Prefecture. Its management philosophy is 'Heart to Heart', and the Annual Securities Report states that it has set out a vision of 'Team Alps' and aims to improve corporate value by leveraging group synergies. Consolidated employees as of December 31, 2025 numbered 6,265, of whom 4,909 were employed by the company on a non-consolidated basis.

entries.77f1bd3fb618698e: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥5,397 million (up 4.6% year on year), ordinary profit was ¥5,543 million (up 4.3%) and profit attributable to owners of parent was ¥3,981 million (up 8.3%). Selling, general and administrative expenses rose to ¥6,715 million (up 4.4%) due to an increase in the number of employees and other factors. By segment, operating profit was ¥4,926 million for the Outsourcing Services Business and ¥533 million for the Global Business.

entries.932614b3963f0e54: A reportable segment centered on the dispatch of design engineers in mechanical, electrical and information processing fields and the commissioned undertaking of technical projects, which also covers general clerical dispatch and commissioned work, dispatch in the agricultural sector, and home-visit nursing care; it is the reportable segment with the largest revenue from external customers of the two reportable segments. This is the core business of the group, centered on engineer dispatch, providing technology through dispatch and contracting. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥47,925 million (up 4.7% year on year), and operating profit was ¥4,926 million (up 0.9% year on year). The securities report states that technical education in advanced technology and environmental fields was strengthened, that utilization rates were kept at a high level in conjunction with sales measures such as team dispatch, and that contract unit prices also rose.

entries.b3cc2d8f9c29f4e2: The [[term:annual-securities-report|Annual Securities Report]] states that the Group (the company, 9 subsidiaries including 7 consolidated subsidiaries, and 2 affiliates) conducts three businesses: the Outsourcing Services Business, the Global Business and Other. Its core is the engineering staffing business, which dispatches design engineers in mechanical, electrical and information processing fields to major manufacturers. Net sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥52,649 million (up 5.6% year on year), of which the company on a non-consolidated basis accounted for 77%. The Annual Securities Report states that the main reason for higher net sales was that both total operating headcount and contract unit prices rose.

The Outsourcing Services Business recorded ¥47,925 million (up 4.7%) and the Global Business ¥4,614 million (up 14.9%). Gross profit was ¥12,112 million (up 4.5%). entries.ef41536d69199a7e: A reportable segment that provides, to Japanese companies overseas and others, design, manufacture, installation and maintenance of plant facilities and machinery and equipment, as well as human resources services and human resource development. The consolidated subsidiaries in Taiwan and Shanghai are responsible for this segment. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥4,614 million (up 14.9% year on year), and operating profit was ¥533 million (up 55.6% year on year).
